name: AXM Deterministic PR Sequencer
actions: read current main and pull-request receiver state from GitHub
bind ordered candidates to exact expected heads and deterministic platform handoffs
select at most one technically ready next candidate
hold on stale base, head drift, missing evidence, draft state, check failure, route drift, unlisted review work, or sequence violation
emit a compact non-authoritative next-action handoff for independent platform review
project which later candidates require refresh if the selected merge advances main
require a complete reprobe after every external action
summary: Select at most one exact next PR for independent platform review while deterministically holding stale or incomplete concurrent work and refusing all merge authority.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL high-consequence read-only advisor. Technical readiness is not review acceptance, merge permission, promotion, roots, or CANON.
